podcast.body: Featured on *The Love Club* EP, this song sold over 10 million units worldwide, becoming one of the rare songs in the last 20 years to be certified Diamond in the United States. It achieved number one status in several countries and earned Lorde a couple of Grammy Awards. "It included a song called Royals. It has since sold more than 10 million units worldwide, making it one of the very few songs at the last 20 years to be certified diamond in the United States. It was a number one single in several countries and it won a couple of Grammy Awards."

podcast.body: This song was a key reason for the astonishment surrounding Lorde's *Pure Heroine* album, as its mature and brilliant composition seemed impossible for someone who was only 16 years old. "How could someone who was just 16 have written something as brilliant and as mature as the song Royals?"

podcast.body: This song, released by Lorde when she was 17, became a worldwide hit in 2013 and served as an anthem for millennials. It was the success of this song that led to her signing with Universal. "And over 2013, it became a worldwide monster, and an anthem for millennials everywhere."
